title: ci(test-ui): an empty diff still selects 691 of 6,657 UI test files (394 because they read the disk or spawn a process), so any UI change starts all 16 Test UI shards — shrink the always-on set
body:
coordinator#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRWWb3MUYRQZiCKQcX

Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer directed. This is recommendation 7 of the 2026-11-08 CI assessment (window 2026-11-01..07). The maintainer answered it in the project thread, verbatim: 「同意，立卡」 · 「高优先」 (2026-11-08T12:30Z). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** A one-line UI fix pays for the whole Test UI battery: 16 shard runners, about 70 runner-minutes per run on the 2026-11-06 sample, on its PR run and again in the queue. A smaller always-on set lets small UI changes start fewer shards and finish sooner.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:ui` seat: the selector is `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs`, and each always-on test is a ui-package test. A `ci.yml` edit is not expected; if one is needed, the PR is Tier H.

## Measured (`main` e516cf22, 2026-11-08)

`node ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs --base HEAD --explain` on an empty diff:

- `changed packages: (none)` and still `always-on test files (the package graph cannot place them): 691`, so 691 of 6,657 tracked test files are selected.
- Reasons, from the `--explain` lines:
  - 394 "reads the disk or spawns a process"
  - 183 "outside every workspace package"
  - 16 "imports @object-ui/plugin-map, which @object-ui/core does not depend on"
  - 13 "imports @object-ui/i18n, which @object-ui/core does not depend on"
  - 12 "reaches packages/plugin-detail outside packages/app-shell"
  - the rest are smaller groups of the same two kinds (an undeclared import, a reach outside the owning package).
- #26084 read 556 always-on files on 2026-10-27, so the set grew by about 135 in twelve days. It also found 0 of 336 Test UI shards empty: affected mode never empties a shard.

## Wanted

1. Classify the 691 by fix:
   - (a) an undeclared dependency or a cross-package reach: declare the dependency, or move the test into the package it tests, so the graph can place it;
   - (b) a disk or process reader that is really scoped to one package: give the selector a way to attribute it (a declared owner, or a narrower reason test), with a self-test case;
   - (c) a test that truly guards everything: it stays always-on, with a one-line reason.
2. Land (a) and (b) in slices, smallest first. A selector change carries a positive and a negative control in the selector's tests.
3. ⛔ No test skipped, quarantined or moved out of Test UI. The `--shard k/16` denominator is unchanged here (it is pinned through `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs`).

## Acceptance

- The empty-diff always-on count is on this card before and after each slice. Target: under 200.
- Three real one-package UI PRs after landing: how many Test UI shards each started, on this card.

**Size:** M–L in slices. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Dedupe

Search 2026-11-08 12:3xZ, open and closed: "Test UI always-on" 161 hits, "always-on files test-ui" 50, "select-affected-tests always" 4. Nearest: #26084 (closed; measured the empty-shard problem and left this half open), #25868 (closed; wired affected mode). Nothing open. **New.**
